claim_boundary: Retrospective mechanism diagnostic on the released official 22-case PhysTwin cohort. Historical outcomes and the development/confirmation split have already informed BayesianPhysTwin. The experiment may test whether correlation-aware evidence tempering creates transferable point-estimate or uncertainty headroom, but it is not fresh validation, calibrated deployment uncertainty, or a state-of-the-art claim.

model.component_family: frozen 5 x 3 historical process/observation standard-deviation grid
model.fallback: last-supported residual trajectory, returned exactly when the prefix validation guard rejects
model.selection: minimum vector RMSE on the permitted fit-to-train validation interval; ties prefer the smaller evidence-count cap
